meta.title: Suggestions register — reviewer chooses the path before anything is implemented
meta.how_to_use: Every row starts with status 'proposed' and decision '(awaiting reviewer)'. A reviewer sets decision to accepted/deferred/rejected, fills decided_by and decided_on, and only then is the suggestion implemented. No suggestion in this register has been implemented by the session.

suggestions.title: Hold a no-bet status quo until a strategy clears 10/10 gates
suggestions.description: Formally keep allocation at zero and publish that decision on the landing page; re-open only when a strategy passes every gate in any lab.
suggestions.benefit: Prevents capital from chasing noise; matches every lab's current 0-qualified result.

suggestions.title: Acquire a licensed historical player-prop price feed
suggestions.description: Source a historical props price archive (or start a forward-only paper props book with logged prices) so prop strategies can be scored at recorded prices.
suggestions.benefit: Unblocks prop ROI measurement (currently impossible); closes the longest-standing data gap.

suggestions.title: Decide the reward-pool funding question
suggestions.description: Reviewer chooses: fund a cash pool, keep a points-only competition, or defer. Record the choice in the pool JSON and on the leaderboard page.
suggestions.benefit: The competition cannot pay rewards until this is decided; points-only is viable but should be explicit.

suggestions.title: Commission a jurisdiction-specific legal review
suggestions.description: Obtain a written review for Calgary, AB covering sportsbook access, advertising rules and personal use before any real-money step.
suggestions.benefit: Only way to answer the legal question with an official source instead of an assumption.

suggestions.title: Build a line-timestamping and CLV logger
suggestions.description: Every originated line gets an ISO timestamp and price; log the eventual closing line to compute CLV per line.
suggestions.benefit: CLV is the fastest honest measure of origination skill; currently uncomputable.

suggestions.title: Add a Friday starter-confirmation sweep
suggestions.description: Each Friday (after inactives), update the injuries page: convert DNP/limited into final Out/active designations and fill the blank QB rows for MIN and BAL once announced.
suggestions.benefit: Turns Wednesday snapshots into decision-grade Friday lineups.

suggestions.title: Add a legal/responsible-use disclaimer
suggestions.description: Publish a disclaimer page linked from every page: research/entertainment use, no wagering advice, no guaranteed outcomes, jurisdiction note.
suggestions.benefit: Removes a compliance gap that currently exists site-wide.

suggestions.title: Automate the official injury-report fetch
suggestions.description: Script the weekly fetch of nfl.com/injuries plus the Wednesday roundup, diff against last week, and write the snapshot JSON automatically (with source URLs and fetch timestamps).
suggestions.benefit: Replaces hand transcription; catches 'No Injuries Reported' contradictions automatically (FL-DD-01).

suggestions.title: Publish machine-readable depth-chart strings per team
suggestions.description: Extract each team's chart into a small JSON (team, position, string1..4) with fetch date and the chart's own 'official/unofficial' label.
suggestions.benefit: Removes the main manual step in the deficiency table; makes replacements queryable.

suggestions.title: Add an availability gate for injury-alpha strategies
suggestions.description: Any strategy that claims injury/depth alpha must pass a pre-registered gate: point-in-time injury inputs (SIG-05), no post-kickoff data, and a stability test across weeks.
suggestions.benefit: Prevents untestable injury claims from entering the competition.

suggestions.title: Run a weekly chart-vs-report consistency check
suggestions.description: Automated diff: players OUT/DNP on the report but absent from the team chart, and chart starters contradicted by transactions (the FL-DD-08 family).
suggestions.benefit: Would have caught WAS/NE/GB/NYG/LV mismatches without manual review.

suggestions.title: Merge the six separate leaderboards into one cross-lab board
suggestions.description: One page ranking all 100 evaluations under a single, documented rule (gates passed, then ROI, with lab provenance on every row).
suggestions.benefit: Today the same idea (e.g. wind-under) appears in four labs with four different gate sets; a reviewer cannot compare them.

suggestions.title: Extend CI to the Decision Desk verifier on every PR
suggestions.description: decision-desk.yml already runs verify_all; add it to the required PR checks alongside validate/checks/build-verify.
suggestions.benefit: Keeps per-row source links and blank-unverified policy enforced after this session.

suggestions.title: Request an official stats/injury API for programmatic access
suggestions.description: Evaluate NFL's official developer/stats endpoints (and nflverse updates) for a licensed feed of injuries and box scores.
suggestions.benefit: Reduces reliance on page scraping; complements S-08.

suggestions.title: Hold a reviewer decision session on the four blocking questions
suggestions.description: Reviewer answers S-01..S-04 (status quo, pool funding, legal review, prop feed) in one pass; results are recorded in this register.
suggestions.benefit: The only path from research to an actual decision.
